title: Females With Severe or Moderate Hemophilia A or B: an International Multi-center Study
brief_summary: This is a multi-center, international study designed to collect clinical, genetic and quality of life information on females with hemophilia, an inherited bleeding disorder. The study is designed to determine whether there are problems and issues unique to females with hemophilia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Females with severe (FVIII\<0.01u/ml) or moderate (FVIII 0.01≤0.05 u/ml) hemophilia A
* Females with severe (FIX\<0.01u/ml) or moderate (FIX 0.01≤0.05u/ml) hemophilia B
* Willingness to participate in the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects who do not meet the inclusion criteria with respect to gender or hemophilia severity.
study_population: Females with severe or moderate Hemophilia A (less than or equal to 5%) Females with severe or moderate Hemophilia B (less than or equal to 5%)
